Its sound joins a mechanical quality to a natural one, giving a clear note of warning that also carries the calm of a Japanese garden; the timbre is plain and recognisable, and suits an antique Eastern musical mood.

鹿威主要由竹材構成，竹筒部分採用空心竹節製作，具有良好的共鳴性能。支撐架構通常使: The shishi-odoshi is made mainly of bamboo: the tube is a hollow bamboo internode section and resonates well. The supports are usually of hardwood such as hinoki or sugi, giving a steady frame. The lever mechanism is of bamboo strip or wood and sets the angle of the tipping. The striking part is of hard wood such as oak or chestnut and hits a fixed wooden pad. The water is led in through a bamboo spout. The whole structure uses natural materials, bamboo and wood, with no metal or leather parts, and keeps the character of raw material.
鹿威的音色清脆而富有穿透力，具有明亮的音質特徵。其音域相對較高，敲擊竹筒時發出的: The shishi-odoshi's sound is crisp and carries well, bright in quality. Its pitch is relatively high, and the knock on the bamboo tube has the clean feel of wood along with a light rhythm. Its resonance is particular: the hollow bamboo lets the sound travel naturally and echo, and outdoors it carries a good distance.

The sōzu is a garden water feature in which a bamboo tube tips and strikes a stone to make a sound, originally used to frighten deer, wild boar and other plant-eating animals. Its function later changed from keeping animals off crops to being part of the visual and aural design of a garden, mainly for appreciation.
